scope: Bounded classical-control coefficient audit only; proof and this protocol frozen before new implementation/execution. No full sampler, random p-coins, model, data/golds, forwards, training, performance or novelty claim.
source: Classical right order-two Bernstein quasi-interpolant with n-1 correction, using exactly the V1 three-point finite difference. See quasi-comparison-v3.md and primary-v3.md.
fixtures: ALL six V1 functions with original rational metadata, no new favorable case selection.
obligations: Every k: original stencil, exactly three value calls, coefficient box, delta=H/n^(3/2), analytic derivative error and safe common denominator.

Every old/new k: independently reconvert power coefficients for degree elevation; compare the reference hypergeometric sum, lower/upper consistency and normalized positive-mixture coefficient when H>0.
Check binomial and hypergeometric first/second/q moments using independent combinatorial weights, without Monte Carlo.
At all rational p: ideal analytic-control error <=7H/(30n^(3/2)), value-only error <=11H/(30n^(3/2)) and valid envelope; H=0 inputs reproduce f exactly.
Every elevation: ideal-control error <=7H/(30m^(3/2)) and value-only error <=241H/(630m^(3/2)).
Retain V1 equal-access query counts and its analytical expected-count bound side by side; include direct cheap polynomial factories, no timing inference.
Refuse invalid metadata/degrees/indices and H=0 mixture normalization; do not clip coefficients or hide a failed assertion.
decision: No generic locality/effective finite-mean separation of V1 survives the written control. A passing finite audit closes this comparison, not the user's positive goal, priority, full software verification or a performance gate. No full sampler/campaign triggered.
